densityHint: Targets the percentage of wall cells within the region, within 2% of its area rounded up to whole cells (at least one cell). Switching layouts resets the target to that layout’s default. If the target and layout rules cannot both be met, nothing is saved.
markerHint: Switch to Place markers, then click cells inside the region to toggle required open cells. Markers are optional and are not saved.
chooseTileFirst: Select one wall tile before continuing.
missingTileset: The selected layer has no available tileset image.
tileDialogHint: Click one tile. Use the mouse wheel to zoom.
tileDialogHintMac: Click one tile. Pinch or use Command + mouse wheel to zoom; scroll with two fingers to pan.
passableWarning: The selected tile is passable; generated walls will not block movement.
ready: Choose a layer and wall tile.
saved: Region generated and saved. Seed: {0}; wall density within the region: {1:F1}%.
conflict: The map changed. Choose the layer and tile again from the reloaded map.
requiresAvalonia: This plug-in requires the Avalonia editor window.
mapUnavailable: The selected map is no longer available.
noValidLayout: No valid layout could be generated for this map.
invalidTile: The selected tile is no longer valid for this tileset.
invalidMode: The selected layout mode is invalid.
invalidDensity: Target wall density must be 20–35% for Lattice or 30–45% for Rooms.
latticeTooSmall: Lattice mode requires a region of at least 7 × 7 cells.
roomsTooSmall: Rooms mode requires a region with a short side of at least 7 cells and an area of at least 81 cells.
markerOutOfBounds: At least one marker is outside the map.
noSafeDensity: Could not reach the target wall density within the allowed tolerance while preserving passages and layout rules. Nothing was saved.
latticeStyleFailed: Could not reach the target density while preserving separated short walls, connected open cells and single-cell gateways. Nothing was saved.
noRoomLayout: Could not reach the target density while preserving small rooms, guarded branches and alternate routes. Nothing was saved.
saveFailed: Could not save the map. Map edits and Undo history are unchanged.
unexpectedError: The operation could not be completed. Reload the map and try again.
